nodes.title: Graphiti Fractal — Retrieval Relevance
nodes.summary: Research thread investigating query-conditioned relevance, ranking, qualification, hard negatives, and Honest Empty boundaries across FM-13 through FM-16.
nodes.why_read: Open when reconstructing why retrieval relevance became the active problem and how FM-13→FM-16 changed the hypothesis space.

research.research_question: Can generic semantic scorers provide reliable mixed-query relevance qualification, and what residual capability remains when they cannot?
research.origin_problem: The tested retrieval path could return the best available candidates even when those candidates did not answer the information need.
prior_evidence: Persistence, temporal supersession, and provenance had separate positive bounded evidence.
FM-13 observed broad candidate noise and zero CrossEncoder calls on the measured path.
FM-14 showed real embeddings improved geometry but did not suppress final false-positive noise.
FM-15 confirmed useful real CrossEncoder pairwise signal on a bounded fixture.
competing_hypotheses: Real embeddings alone may fix the relevance problem.
A pairwise CrossEncoder may provide useful discrimination.
One global raw threshold may convert a good scorer into reliable mixed-query qualification.
A later residual mechanism may need query understanding, structure, memory-specific recognition, or another bounded mechanism; none is promoted by FM-16 alone.
results: CrossEncoder ranking was stronger than the embedding baseline on the frozen FM-16 fixture.
Neither score family had a feasible single global threshold under the frozen mixed-query constraints.
limitations: Strict later blind-test scoring order was not satisfied because TEST scores were generated before threshold freeze, although threshold selection itself was CAL-only.
rejected_interpretations: CE ranking better means global qualification solved.
theta=null means no relevant memory exists.
FM-16 proves the next architecture must be structural filtering, LLM recognition, graph/path scoring, or any other single mechanism.
open_questions: What minimal observable and least-assumption-heavy mechanism removes the residual relevance error class?
